name: checkup-brief
description: 把体检报告，变成一页能看懂的人话简报。Turn your checkup report into a one-page brief you can actually understand.
author: TTNAN

scripts.example: node bin/checkup-brief.js examples/sample-report.txt --age 32 --sex male --budget 1500 > examples/sample-brief.md && node bin/checkup-brief.js examples/sample-report.txt --json > examples/sample-report.json
